metadata.title: Project Zomboid Modding Search Vocabulary & Taxonomy
metadata.description: Guided taxonomy of search parameters, blocks, tags, item types, components, flags, and translation types. Extensible: agents can append new search terms when discovered.

normal.description: Standard items, crafting ingredients, miscellaneous goods

weapon.description: Hand weapons, melee weapons (blades, blunts), ranged firearms

food.description: Edible and perishable items with nutritional values

container.description: Wearable bags, backpacks, pouches, boxes, cases

drainable.description: Items with limited uses, fluids, batteries, thread, glue

clothing.description: Wearable clothing, helmets, vests, armor with protection values

key.description: Keys matching doors, vehicles, or padlocks

alarmclock.description: Alarm clocks and watches with timer/beeping mechanics

literature.description: Books, magazines, skill manuals, recipe learning items

craftbench.description: Used to add a crafting bench property to an [entity ](https://pz-wiki-modding.github.io/PZ-API-Docs/scripts/entity.html)

fluidcontainer.description: Adds a fluid container to an item

prop1.description: Item held in primary hand during timed action animation

prop2.description: Item held in secondary hand during timed action animation

maydegradelight.description: Tool has a chance to lose a small amount of durability

maydegradeheavy.description: Tool has a high chance to lose significant durability

allowdestroyeditem.description: Allows using a broken or 0-condition item as input

notfull.description: Item must not be completely full (e.g. for filling fluid/fuel)

allowfavorite.description: Allows crafting even if the item is marked as favorite

inheritfavorite.description: Output item inherits the favorite status of the input

itemcount.description: Matches input based on internal item count or stack

inhandcraft.description: Can be crafted directly from hands without standing near a surface

anysurfacecraft.description: Requires a flat surface or tabletop nearby

canbedoneindark.description: Player does not require a light source to craft

canbedonefromfloor.description: Input items can be pulled directly from adjacent floor tiles

heatsource.description: Requires an active heat source (campfire, stove, oven, forge)

cookable.description: Evolves or finishes through cooking heat

sharpknife.description: Requires a cutting or carving knife

itemname.description: Item display names in translations/<LANG>/ItemName_<LANG>.json (Key format: Module.ItemID)

recipes.description: Recipe display names in translations/<LANG>/Recipes_<LANG>.json (Key format: RecipeID)

ui.description: General UI labels, headers, and tooltips in UI_<LANG>.json

contextmenu.description: Right-click context menu options in ContextMenu_<LANG>.json (Key prefix: ContextMenu_)

bodyparts.description: Body part names in BodyParts_<LANG>.json (Key prefix: BODYPART_)

attributes.description: Character attributes and stat tooltips in Attributes_<LANG>.json

sandbox.description: Custom sandbox options in Sandbox_<LANG>.json (Key prefix: Sandbox_)

multiplayer.description: Server and multiplayer UI localizations in Multiplayer_<LANG>.json
